title: Ragga Druqks Pressure
prompt: drum n bass meets aphex twin with ambient intros
description: A sub-heavy beatless drone with distant dub stabs opens into a chopped, ragga-tinged 808 break and a growling detuned reese bass. Two driving peaks bracket a darker valley breakdown, with crushed stabs, vowel-filtered chords and a long reverberant tail.
code:
setcpm(165/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").gain(0.85).lpf(220).room(0.4),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(700).room(0.7).delay(".5:.375:.6").gain(0.42).vowel("<a o>"),
    s("~ ~ ~ sh").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).room(0.6).hpf(500)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").gain(0.9).lpf(240),
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).shape(0.3),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).cut(1),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(900).room(0.5).gain(0.48).crush(7)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("c1*2 <eb1 g0> c1").s("supersaw").lpf(sine.slow(16).range(400,1600)).resonance(8).gain(0.7).shape(0.45).detune(0.4),
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd] ~ sd bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).shape(0.35).every(4, x => x.rev()),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.45).cut(1).ply("<1 1 2 4>").pan(0.6),
    s("~ oh ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).hpf(400),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(1100).room(0.4).gain(0.5).crush(8).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 ab0>").s("sine").gain(0.85).lpf(200),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]> <[f2,ab2,c3,eb3]> <[g2,bb2,d3,f3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(800).room(0.8).delay(".5:.375:.7").gain(0.45).vowel("<a e o>").slow(2),
    s("~ ~ ~ cr").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).room(0.7)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("c1*2 <eb1 g0> [c1 c1]").s("supersaw").lpf(sine.slow(12).range(500,2200)).resonance(10).gain(0.72).shape(0.5).detune(0.5),
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd] bd [~ sd] bd*2 sd").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).shape(0.4).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(1.5)).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)),
    s("cp(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).room(0.3).crush(6),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(1400).room(0.4).gain(0.5).crush(8).vowel("<e o>").off(0.1875, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 ab0 g0>").s("sine").gain(0.85).lpf(saw.slow(16).range(600,180)),
    s("bd ~ sd ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.8).shape(0.2).degradeBy(0.3),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3,bb3]> ~ ~").s("sawtooth").lpf(700).room(0.8).delay(".5:.375:.7").gain(0.4).vowel("<a o>")
  )]
)
